name: imbrace-developer
description: Build on the iMBrace platform from your coding agent: get started, use the TypeScript/Python SDK, connect the hosted MCP server, drive the CLI, and build AI agents, workflows, knowledge hubs and CRM boards.

mcp_url.title: iMBrace MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Gateway MCP endpoint. Production: https://app-gatewayv2.imbrace.co/mcp, sandbox: https://app-gateway.sandbox.imbrace.co/mcp. Where the gateway has OAuth enabled, sign in with /mcp > imbrace > Authenticate and pick the organization and access; otherwise add the server with an API key (see the plugin README).
